entities.summary: Jakub Menšík is a Czech professional tennis player. He has a career-high ATP singles ranking of world No. 12, achieved on 2 March 2026, and a doubles ranking of No. 271, achieved on 18 August 2025. He is currently the No. 2 Czech player in men's singles.
